messages:
tina_support: FYI customer reported invoice shows ~18k tokens in billing line item but their dashboard for the same period shows ~9k. They attached request logs. Seems spikes line up with a mobile release last week.

mike_billing: Can you paste the invoice line and the dashboard export? we need the invoice id + date range to match ledger rows.

tina_support: Invoice INV-2025-0612, period 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-03. Dashboard export attached by PM but here's the customer summary: tokens_in_dashboard=9321, invoice_tokens=17984.

oliver_sre: Do we have any reports of gateway retries or duplicated writes for that period? I'll grep the proxy logs for that account.

sre-bot: Searching ledger writes for account acme-inc between 2025-06-02T00:00:00Z and 2025-06-03T00:00:00Z... found 1,782 write events. Correlating request-ids...

oliver_sre: Early hit: a cluster of writes from same client time window all have different api_key values but share a short-lived client request-id header. Looks like mobile SDK rotated ephemeral keys on retries, causing multiple ledger attributions.

mike_billing: Wait, how are we deduping? Our dedupe key is (idempotency_key, api_key). If the client rotates keys mid-retry, identical idempotency_key is not seen with the same api_key and ledger double-writes can happen.

devex-anna: That's subtle — mobile SDK rotates ephemeral tokens every 30s. If the client starts a request, hits a timeout, SDK refreshes token and retries without preserving the original api_key, dedupe won't catch it. We need repro steps to confirm.

oliver_sre: Repro plan: run mobile emulator with ephemeral key rotation enabled, send a long-generation call that exceeds 10s, force a timeout at the load-balancer, let SDK retry with fresh token and same X-Idempotency-Key. I can script this.

tina_support: Customer provided sample client log (sanitized):

```
I 2025-06-02T12:34:10Z Request start id=rcv-4a2b x-idempotency=abcd-1234 api_key=ephemeral_eyJ1
W 2025-06-02T12:34:21Z Timeout, retrying
I 2025-06-02T12:34:22Z Request start id=rcv-4a2b x-idempotency=abcd-1234 api_key=ephemeral_eyJ2
```

mike_billing: That log matches the hypothesis. Two requests with same idempotency header but different api_key strings. Our ledger attach uses api_key as primary customer identity for that write, so second write attributed separately.

oliver_sre: I ran the repro in staging. Confirmed: when api_key changes between retries our dedupe misses and both tokens are charged. Ledger_write ids: lw-889 and lw-890 with identical request bodies.

devex-anna: Customer impact: double-charge on retried requests that cross key rotation boundary. Not all retries — only those where token refresh happened during request lifetime. That's why dashboard (based on successful unique request IDs attributed to original api_key) shows less. Invoice is ledger-level and counted both writes.

mike_billing: Severity? estimate number of affected tokens for that invoice.

oliver_sre: For INV-2025-0612 window, I aggregated duplicated request signatures and estimate ~8,400 duplicated tokens — matches difference.

mike_billing: OK. Next steps: 1) short-term: issue customer credit and mark invoices for manual adjustment. 2) medium-term: change dedupe logic to ignore api_key and dedupe on (idempotency_key, request_hash) for time window T. 3) devex: update SDK to preserve original ephemeral key in retry metadata or set a stable retry-id that gateway can use.

tina_support: Customer asks whether we can auto-detect and refund similar accounts. Should we run a search for patterns?

oliver_sre: Yes — run query for duplicate idempotency_key values with different api_key within 120s and same request_hash. I can produce a list of affected accounts; flagging likely candidates.

mike_billing: I'll prepare credit memos once we have the affected ledger rows. Also need to notify accounting and update internal KB.

devex-anna: SDK mitigation: add header X-Original-Ephemeral-Key and X-Retry-Root-Id so retries keep a stable attribution even if token rotates. I'll draft PR and a patch release.

oliver_sre: Ops mitigation: I'll push a gateway-side patch to dedupe across keys for the next 7-day window as a config flag (safe rollout, opt-in per tenant). After we validate, we can enable globally.

mike_billing: Action items: oliver - run detection query and export ledger rows (due EOD). devex-anna - open SDK PR and include migration notes (due +2d). billing - prepare draft credit notes (due +1d). tina - reply to customer with interim credit and ETA.

tina_support: I'll send the customer an acknowledgement now with the interim credit and ETA. cc @mike_billing for amounts.

sre-bot: Reminder: run the dedupe-search job with query id dedupe-search-1746987654 when oliver posts the export.

mike_billing: Thanks team. Keep thread updated. We'll also add a monitoring alert to detect sudden token deltas between dashboard and ledger for any tenant > 5k tokens in a 24h window.

oliver_sre: Export uploaded to /investigations/1746987654/ledger-duplicates.csv and query saved. Starting detection sweep now.

tina_support: Customer acknowledged and on-call support scheduled for follow-up tomorrow.

mike_billing: Closing loop once credits applied. Please tag me when the export is final.
